run_doctest_iterator: run the doctest module to verify Boost.Python iterator bindings for list_int and range types
test_boost_python_iterator_bindings: test the Boost.Python iterator bindings by running doctests on list_int push_back and back methods
test_range_iterator_wrapping: test that range objects wrap C++ iterators correctly by iterating over a list_int instance
test_range2_transform_iterator: test the range2 transform_iterator that doubles elements when iterating over a list_int
test_nested_list_iteration: test nested list iteration by pushing list_int objects into a list_list and iterating over them
